ns2:course.label: Essentials of Business Management
ns2:course.description: This course provides an understanding of theoretical and historical perspectives on business and capitalism. Covers basic principles of business strategy; understanding of financial accounting and budgeting; the importance of ethics; principles of leadership; and the importance of the global business environment. 3 graduate hours. No professional credit. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. Prerequisite: Restricted to MS: SBC Students.
